summary: 秘鲁卡拉尔遗址虽少见陶器，测年与建筑布局却显示它是一座年代久远、已有社会分工的城市。从棉花遗存和同期渔网推断，内陆居民可能以制网材料换取沿海渔获。
logic: 发掘与测年推早城市年代
住宅差异显示社会层次
寻找维持城市的交换品
由棉花和渔网重建沿海贸易

paragraphs.brief: 荒漠土丘下的古老城市
sentences: Huge earth and rock mounds rise out of the desert of the Supe Valley near the coast of Peru in South America.
南美洲秘鲁近海的苏佩河谷沙漠中，矗立着巨大的土石丘。
These immense mounds appear simply to be part of the geographical landscape in this arid region squeezed between the Pacific Ocean and the Andes mountains.
乍看之下，这些土丘不过是太平洋与安第斯山脉之间这片干旱地区的自然景观。
But looks deceive.
但外表会骗人。
These are actually human-made pyramids.
它们其实是人工建造的金字塔。
Strong evidence indicates they are the remains of a city known as Caral that flourished nearly 5,000 years ago.
有力证据表明，这是卡拉尔城的遗迹，该城近五千年前已十分繁荣。
If true, it would be the oldest known urban center in the Americas and among the most ancient in the world.
如果属实，它就是美洲已知最早的城市中心，也跻身世界最古老的城市之列。
paragraphs.gist: 秘鲁苏佩河谷貌似天然的土丘实际是人工金字塔，证据表明近五千年前此处已有繁荣城市，可能是美洲已知最早的城市中心。

paragraphs.brief: 金字塔规模促使沙迪发掘
sentences: Research undertaken by Peruvian archaeologist Ruth Shady suggests that the 150-acre complex of pyramids, plazas and residential buildings was a thriving metropolis when Egypt’s great pyramids were still being built.
沙迪的研究表明，当埃及的大金字塔仍在建设时，这片占地150英亩、包含金字塔、广场和住宅的建筑群已是一座繁荣的城市。
Though discovered in 1905, for years Caral attracted little attention, largely because archaeologists believed the structures were fairly recent.
卡拉尔虽在1905年就被发现，但多年鲜有人注意，主要因为考古学家以为这些建筑年代较近。

But the monumental scale of the pyramids had long interested Shady, who began excavations at the site in 1996, about 22 kilometers from the coast and 190 kilometers north of Peru’s capital city of Lima.
宏伟的金字塔却一直吸引着沙迪，她于1996年开始发掘这处遗址；这里离海岸约22公里，在秘鲁首都利马以北约190公里。
paragraphs.gist: 卡拉尔虽于1905年被发现，却长期被当作较晚的遗迹，金字塔的巨大规模促使秘鲁考古学家沙迪于1996年展开挖掘。

sentences: Shady and her crew searched for broken remains of the pots and containers that most such sites contain.
沙迪和团队寻找大多数同类遗址都会有的陶罐、容器碎片。
Not finding any only made her more excited; it meant Caral could be what archaeologists term pre-ceramic, that is, existing before the advent in the area of pot-firing techniques.
一片也没找到反而使她更兴奋，因为卡拉尔可能属于考古学所说的前陶器时代，即当地出现烧陶技术以前。
Shady’s team undertook the task of excavating Piramide Mayor, the largest of the pyramids.
沙迪的团队着手发掘最大的金字塔，即大金字塔。
After carefully clearing away many hundreds of years’ worth of rubble and sand, they identified staircases, walls covered with remnants of colored woven bags and brickwork.
仔细清除积累数百年的碎石和沙土后，他们辨认出阶梯、砖砌结构，以及留有彩色编织袋残片的墙壁。
In the foundations, they found the remains of grass-like reeds woven into bags.
他们在地基中发现了用草状芦苇编成的袋子残骸。

The original workers, she surmised, must have filled these bags with stones from a nearby quarry and laid them atop one another inside retaining walls, gradually giving rise to the pyramid’s immense structure.
沙迪推测，建造者应是用袋子装入附近采石场的石块，在挡土墙内一层层堆叠，逐步筑起巨大的金字塔。
Shady had samples of the reeds subjected to radiocarbon dating and found that the reeds were 4,600 years old.
对芦苇样本的放射性碳测年显示，它们已有四千六百年历史。
This evidence indicated that Caral was, in fact, more than 1,000 years older than what had previously been thought to be the oldest urban center in the Americas.
这表明卡拉尔比此前被认为是美洲最古老的城市中心还要早一千多年。
paragraphs.gist: 沙迪因找不到陶片而怀疑遗址属于前陶器时代，随后地基中装石芦苇袋约四千六百年的测年结果为其古老年代提供了证据。

paragraphs.brief: 遗址中的分工、音乐与等级
sentences: What amazed archaeologists was not just the age, but the complexity and scope of Caral.
卡拉尔不仅年代古老，其规模和复杂程度也令考古学家惊讶。
Piramide Mayor alone covers an area nearly the size of four football fields and is 18 meters tall.
仅大金字塔就高十八米，占地接近四个足球场。
A nine-meter-wide staircase rises from a circular plaza at the foot of the pyramid, passing over three terraced levels until it reaches the top.
九米宽的楼梯从塔脚的圆形广场向上延伸，越过三层平台直通塔顶。
Thousands of manual laborers would have been needed to build such a project, not counting the many architects, craftsmen, and managers.
光体力劳动者就需要数千人，这还不算诸多建筑师、工匠和管理人员。
Shady’s team found the remains of a large amphitheater, containing almost 70 musical instruments made of bird and deer bones.
沙迪的团队还发现了一座大型露天剧场的遗迹，内有近七十件用鸟骨和鹿骨制成的乐器。
Clearly, music played an important role in Caral’s society.
显然，音乐在卡拉尔社会占有重要地位。
Around the perimeter of Caral are a series of smaller mounds and various buildings.
卡拉尔外围分布着一系列较小的土丘和各种建筑。
These indicate a hierarchy of living arrangements: large, well-kept rooms atop pyramids for the elite, ground-level quarters for craftsmen, and shabbier outlying dwellings for workers.
它们反映了居住等级：精英住金字塔顶宽大整洁的房间，工匠住地面的房舍，工人则住在外围较简陋的住所。
paragraphs.gist: 巨型金字塔所需的大量人力、剧场里的近七十件骨制乐器，以及等级分明的住所，共同勾勒出卡拉尔复杂的城市社会。

sentences: But why had Caral been built in the first place?
可是，人们当初为什么要建造卡拉尔城呢？
Her excavations convinced Shady that Caral once served as a trade center for the region, which extends from the rainforests of the Amazon to the high forests of the Andes.
沙迪通过发掘确信，卡拉尔曾是区域贸易中心，其影响范围从亚马逊雨林延伸到安第斯山高地的森林。
Shady found evidence of a rich trading environment, including seeds of the cocoa bush and necklaces of shells, neither of which was native to the immediate Caral area.
她发现多种贸易兴盛的证据，包括可可种子和贝壳项链，两者都不是卡拉尔邻近地区的物产。
This environment gave rise to people who did not take part in the production of food, allowing them to become priests and planners, builders and designers.
这样的环境使一些人可以脱离食物生产，成为祭司、规划者、建造者和设计者。
Thus occupational specialization, elemental to an urban society, emerged.
于是，城市社会的基本特征之一，即职业分工，便出现了。
paragraphs.gist: 当地原本不产的可可种子和贝壳项链表明卡拉尔可能是贸易中心，交换活动也让祭司、规划者和工匠等专职角色成为可能。

paragraphs.brief: 灌溉作物与囤粮说之疑
sentences: But what sustained such a trading center and drew travelers to it?
又是什么维系了这样一座贸易中心，把往来的旅人吸引到这里？
Was it food?
是食物吗？
Shady and her team found the bones of small edible fish, which must have come from the Pacific coast to the west, in the excavations.
沙迪团队在发掘中找到小型食用鱼的骨头，这些鱼应来自西面的太平洋海岸。
But they also found evidence of squash, sweet potatoes and beans having been grown locally.
他们也发现南瓜、甘薯和豆类曾在当地种植的证据。
Shady theorized that Caral’s early farmers diverted the area’s rivers into canals, which still cross the Supe Valley today, to irrigate their fields.
沙迪推测，早期居民将当地河水引入至今仍横穿苏佩河谷的渠道，以灌溉田地。
But because she found no traces of maize, which can be traded or stored and used in times of crop failure, she concluded that Caral’s trade leverage was not based on stockpiling food supplies.
但她没发现玉米，而玉米本可交易，也可储藏以备歉收，因此她认为卡拉尔的贸易优势并非建立在囤粮上。
paragraphs.gist: 鱼骨和农作物遗存显示当地既有沿海食物也有灌溉农业，但缺少便于储备交易的玉米，让沙迪怀疑城市靠囤粮获得贸易优势的说法。

paragraphs.brief: 用棉网向渔民交换海产
sentences: It was evidence of another crop in the excavations that gave Shady the best clue to Caral’s success.
另一种作物的出土，为沙迪解释卡拉尔的繁荣提供了最有力的线索。
In nearly every excavated building, her team discovered evidence of cotton— seeds, fibers and textiles.
她的团队几乎在每一座出土建筑中都发现了棉籽、棉纤维或棉织物。
Her theory fell into place when a large fishing net made of those fibers, unearthed in an unrelated dig on Peru’s coast, turned out to be as old as Caral.
秘鲁海岸另一处发掘发现用相同纤维制成的大渔网，年代与卡拉尔相当，这让她的推测有了完整的解释。
“The farmers of Caral grew the cotton that the fishermen needed to make their nets,” Shady speculates.
沙迪推测：“卡拉尔农民种植渔民需要用来织网的棉花。
“And the fishermen gave them shellfish and dried fish in exchange for these nets.”
渔民则用贝类和鱼干换取这些网。”

In essence, the people of Caral enabled fishermen to work with larger and more effective nets, which made the resources of the sea more readily available, and the fishermen probably used dried squash grown by the Caral people as flotation devices for their nets.
卡拉尔人让渔民能用更大、更有效的网获取海产，渔民还可能用卡拉尔人种的晒干葫芦给渔网作浮子。
paragraphs.gist: 城中随处可见棉籽、纤维和织物，同期海岸遗址又出土棉网，沙迪由此推测农民用制网的棉料换取渔民的贝类和鱼干。

items.en: Caral was built at the same time as the construction of the Egyptian pyramids.
items.zh: 卡拉尔城与埃及金字塔是在同一时期建造的。
items.why: 题干说“建造同时期”,原文说“埃及金字塔建造时，卡拉尔已繁荣 (已建成并兴盛)”,不是“正在建造”。时间逻辑相反，故为 False。

items.en: The absence of pottery at the archaeological dig gave Shady a significant clue to the age of the site.
items.zh: 遗址没有出土陶器，这为沙迪推断它的年代提供了一条重要线索。
items.why: 没有发现陶器使沙迪想到遗址可能早于当地制陶时代，为判断年代提供了线索。

items.en: The stones used to build Piramide Mayor came from a location far away.
items.zh: 建造大金字塔（Piramide Mayor）所用的石料来自很远的地方。
items.why: 沙迪推测工人从附近采石场取石装袋建塔，距离与题干的“远方”相反。

items.en: The huge and complicated structures of Piramide Mayor suggest that its construction required an organised team of builders.
items.zh: 大金字塔规模庞大、构造复杂，可见建造它需要一支组织有序的施工队伍。
items.why: 文中说建造者中有工人、建筑师、工匠和管理者，表明这么大的工程需要分工合作。

items.en: Archaeological evidence shows that the residents of Caral were highly skilled musicians.
items.zh: 考古证据表明，卡拉尔的居民是技艺高超的乐手。
items.why: 文中只说明“音乐重要/有乐器”,没说他们“技艺高超 (highly skilled)”,信息缺失，故 NG。

items.en: The remains of housing areas at Caral suggest that there were no class distinctions in residential areas.
items.zh: 卡拉尔住宅区的遗迹表明，当地居民的住所没有阶级之分。
items.why: 明确有“等级 (hierarchy)”,与“无阶层差异” 相反，故 False。
原文说当地不产这种植物，却出土了它的 seeds，即种子。

items.zh: 发现了曾用来制作首饰的________。
items.why: “necklaces of shells” 制作首饰的材料为 shells。题干要求材料而非“necklace”。

items.en: the remains of certain food such as ________
items.zh: 发现了食物的残留物，例如________。
items.why: 题干要食物名称。原文给出“fish” 的骨头，且来自海岸，非本地。

items.en: ________ still in existence today indicate water diverted from rivers
items.zh: 今天仍然存在的________表明，当地人曾从河中引水。
items.why: “still…today” 与题干“仍存在”精确对应。

items.zh: 没有证据表明当地种植过________。
items.why: 定位句说：“但她没发现玉米，而玉米本可交易，也可储藏以备歉收，因此她认为卡拉尔的贸易优势并非建立在囤粮上。”

items.en: the excavation findings and fishing nets found on the coast suggest Caral farmers traded ________
items.zh: 出土物与沿海发现的渔网表明，卡拉尔的农民曾用________进行交易。
items.why: 定位句说：“沙迪推测：“卡拉尔农民种植渔民需要用来织网的棉花。”

items.en: dried squash may have been used to aid ________ of fishing nets
items.zh: 晒干的葫芦可能有助于渔网________。
items.why: 名词化为 flotation,与题干“帮助.的 (过程/功能)” 匹配。一词作答。

groups.instructionsZh: 先回想空格里的英文。每空填一个词。

pairs: 题干用形容词，定位句改用同词根的名词。
第 3 段 · 第 8 句
points: 沙迪推测工人从附近采石场取石装袋建塔，距离与题干的“远方”相反。
原文说当地不产这种植物，却出土了它的 seeds，即种子。
clauses: Though discovered in 1905, for years Caral attracted little attention, ….
连接词 because 引出“largely because archaeologists believed the structures were fairly recent”，说明主句的原因关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 because 把这一层关系补进去。
But the monumental scale of the pyramids had long interested Shady, …, about 22 kilometers from the coast and 190 kilometers north of Peru’s capital city of Lima.
“who began excavations at the site in 1996”修饰前面的 Shady。先认出先行词，再读从句补充的特征。
读到 who 时，回看 Shady，再把修饰信息接回主句。
